<title>Welcome to LWC Communities!</title>

<!-- branding stylesheets -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part1.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part2.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part3.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part4.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />

<!-- branding stylesheets-->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/print.css }" media="print"/>

<style>
    .comm-section-container:has(.slds-global-actions__notifications) {
      width: 100% !important;
    }
    .comm-section-container:has(c-account-dashboard) {
      width: 100vw;
      padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .columns-content:has(c-account-dashboard) {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .content-container:has(c-account-dashboard) {
      background: var(--nc-layout-content-bg, #fff);
    }

    :host(.arc-sidebar-collapsed) {
      --arc-sidebar-width: 56px;
      --slds-c-card-radius-border: var(--div-radius-lg);
      --slds-c-card-radius-border: var(--div-radius-lg);
      --slds-c-card-shadow: none;
      --slds-c-card-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
      --slds-c-card-footer-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
      --sds-c-card-radius-border: var(--div-radius-lg);
      --sds-c-card-shadow: none;
      --sds-c-card-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
      --sds-c-card-footer-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
    }
    .slds-card,
    .slds-card_boundary {
      border: var(--div-border-card);
      border-radius: var(--div-radius-lg);
      box-shadow: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .slds-card__header {
      border-bottom-color: var(--div-color-border);
    }
    .slds-card__footer {
      border-top-color: var(--div-color-border);
    }

    .slds-card {
      box-shadow: none !important;
      border-radius: var(--slds-g-radius-border-3, 12px) !important;
    }

    .notification-row .notification-text {
      font-family: var(--div-font-family-base) !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .notification-row .titleName {
      font-family: var(--div-font-family-base) !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-3, 1.5rem) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .titleName {
      font-weight: 700 !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .notification-text-title {
      font-weight: 600 !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .titleOptions {
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .notification-text,
    .div-notification-container .notification-age {
      color: var(--div-color-neutral-50) !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }
    
    search_results-navigation {
        --dxp-crm-search-border-radius: var(--div-control-radius) !important;
        --dxp-crm-search-box-shadow: none !important;
    }
    
    iframe html {
        background: #fff !important;
    }
    
    .div-notification-container .notificationPanel {
        border: var(--div-border-card) !important;
		overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--div-radius-lg) !important;
    }
    
    .global-header-actions .column-content {
        flex-direction: row !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        gap: .75rem !important;
    }
    
    .global-header-actions .column-content > * {
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .desktop-direction-row {
        width: 100% !important;
    }
    /* Header below the desktop breakpoint (64.0625em): keep it one row.
       The header is a fixed 54px bar (themeLayoutSidebar); the platform's
       columns switch to a stacked column layout on tablet/mobile widths,
       which pushed the logo and the search/icons row out of the bar and over
       the page. A Retina laptop window (2 device px per CSS px) under ~1025
       CSS px is enough to hit it. Builder preview pins the LARGE form factor,
       so it only ever showed on the live site. The size classes below are the
       header's own desktop column widths, kept at every width. */
    @media only screen and (max-width: 64em) {
      .theme-layout__header .columns {
        flex-direction: row !important;
      }
      .theme-layout__header dxp_layout-column {
        width: auto !important;
      }
      .theme-layout__header dxp_layout-column.col-large-size_1-of-12,
      .theme-layout__header dxp_layout-column.col-large-size_2-of-12 {
        flex: 0 0 auto !important;
      }
      .theme-layout__header dxp_layout-column.col-large-size_10-of-12,
      .theme-layout__header dxp_layout-column.col-large-size_11-of-12 {
        flex: 1 1 auto !important;
        min-width: 0 !important;
      }
    }

</style>
